title: Rectangles and Squares
sourceStudentTask: Draw FIVE rectangles, explaining the defining shape attributes.

teacherRubric.required: Five valid closed four-sided figures with four right angles; squares remain a subtype of rectangle. At least some size/orientation variety is considered.
The teacher validates defining geometric attributes, correct counts or decompositions, and a mathematical explanation consistent with the learner's own actual drawn/composed object.
The source requires a physical or drawn representation and verbal or recorded work. Naming a shape or number digitally is a partial assessment only.
The teacher can examine authentic learner-produced drawings or tracings only after these occur during learning; readiness of the rubric does not imply observed real student work.
